- [USER] I still see the same screen, it is not adjusted.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] One common issue is that the viewport meta tag is not set correctly in the HTML head. Make sure you have the following code in your HTML head: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This tells the browser to set the width of the viewport to the width of the device, and to set the initial zoom level to 1.0.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If you've already included the viewport meta tag and the issue persists, please let me know and I can try to provide further assistance.
